_note: Rewards for taking part with other players (requirements R5). Paid by the database (public.social_rewards_config() in *_social_rewards.sql mirrors this exactly; checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs). A guest or listener counts once they've stayed stayMinutes; only accounts at least minAccountDays old with a verified email count or earn (the follow reward excepted). A bigger party or Space tier replaces a smaller one the same day: the difference is paid.
